## Vocabulary Matching (9 points)
For each definition, select the correct word or phrase. Each correct match is worth 1 point.
**1.** Select the word or phrase for each definition. (3 points)
Write the letter of the matching option.
| 1. absence from school without permission | ____ | A. incarceration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2. being kept in a prison or jail | ____ | B. truancy |
| 3. a feeling that someone deserves no respect | ____ | C. disdain |
Correct answer: <i>1–B, 2–A, 3–C</i>
